cards.front: 21. Celine Dion has been my _____ since I was young.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. idol = thần tượng.

my idol = thần tượng của tôi.

cards.front: 22. We were surprised to know that over 150000 _____ packed into the stadium to support Vietnamese football team.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. fans = người hâm mộ.

Ngữ cảnh “support Vietnamese football team” phù hợp nhất với fans.

cards.front: 23. But for your support, our band couldn’t have won the Grand Music _____.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. competition = cuộc thi.

Cụm: win a competition.

cards.front: 24. Our performance was _____ to be the best one in this competition last night.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. judged.

Cấu trúc: be judged to be = được đánh giá là.

cards.front: 25. In the last quarter of this year, our entertainment company had a big success in signing a lot of _____ with celebrities.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. contracts = hợp đồng.

Cụm: sign contracts with somebody.

cards.front: 26. Chopin was considered to be one of the greatest Romantic piano _____ of the 19th century.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. composers = nhà soạn nhạc.

Chopin là nhà soạn nhạc piano nổi tiếng.

cards.front: 27. We’re seeking for the _____ musician to join our entertainment company.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. talented = có tài năng.

Cụm tự nhiên: a talented musician.

cards.front: 28. These games are challenging, _____ it’s not easy to spend little time playing them.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. so = vì vậy.

Mệnh đề sau là kết quả của mệnh đề trước.

cards.front: 29. I didn’t want to continue watching the show _____ it was more and more boring later.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. for = vì/bởi vì.

Mệnh đề sau giải thích lý do.

cards.front: 30. He can’t decide whether to buy the tickets for the music show online _____ at the box office.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. or.

Cấu trúc: whether ... or ...

cards.front: 31. Smoking is extremely detrimental to health, _____ many people continue to smoke anyway.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. yet = tuy nhiên/nhưng.

Hai mệnh đề mang ý tương phản.

cards.front: 32. Do you like singing _____ dancing?
cards.explanation:
✓ D. or = hay.

Dùng để đưa ra hai lựa chọn.

cards.front: 33. I admire Celine Dion _____ she has a nice voice.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. for = vì/bởi vì.

Mệnh đề sau nêu lý do.

cards.front: 34. He lost the key, _____ he couldn't get into the house.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. so = vì vậy.

Mất chìa khóa → kết quả là không vào nhà được.

cards.front: 35. We were lost in the forest, _____ luckily my friend had a map in his backpack.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. but = nhưng.

Hai ý tương phản: bị lạc nhưng may mắn có bản đồ.

cards.front: 36. Pop music is so popular, _____ the melody is simple and memorable.
cards.explanation:
✓ A. for = vì/bởi vì.

Mệnh đề sau giải thích lý do pop music phổ biến.

cards.front: 37. Would you like a cup of milk tea _____ a cup of hot chocolate after dinner?
cards.explanation:
✓ B. or = hay.

Dùng khi đưa ra hai lựa chọn.

cards.front: 38. Minh had his teeth decayed, _____ he refused to see the dentist.
cards.explanation:
✓ D. but = nhưng.

Hai ý trái ngược: răng sâu nhưng từ chối đi nha sĩ.

cards.front: 39. You must do well in the test, _____ you will not graduate.
cards.explanation:
✓ B. or = nếu không.

Cấu trúc: imperative/must ..., or ... = nếu không thì ...

cards.front: 40. Anna thinks she ought to go to the university, _____ she wants to get qualifications for her dream job.
cards.explanation:
✓ C. for = vì/bởi vì.

Mệnh đề sau nêu lý do cô ấy nghĩ nên vào đại học.
